representation: Use residual coordinates r=Ax and the without-replacement Markov state (R,r), where R is the set of coordinates not yet updated in the current epoch. For i in R, set B_i=I-Ae_i e_i^T, so the transition is (R,r)->(R\{i},B_i r). Represent expected future energy capture by quadratic Bellman functions G_R(r)=r^T H_R r, with H_empty=0 and H_R=|R|^{-1} sum_{i in R}[e_i e_i^T+B_i^T H_{R\{i}}B_i]. The PSD cone and its rank-one dual witnesses provide the certification/falsification interface.
state_or_invariant: Retain the exact pathwise identity ||x'||_A^2=||x||_A^2-r_i^2 for an update of coordinate i. Consequently, r^T H_R r is exactly the conditional expected sum of future squared selected residuals, and at an epoch boundary E||T_pi x||_A^2=||x||_A^2-(Ax)^T H_[n](Ax).
core_candidate_lemma: Candidate lemma: there exists a universal eta in (0,1) such that, for every dimension and every real unit-diagonal SPD A with mu=lambda_min(A), the Bellman capture matrix satisfies H_[n] >= eta*mu*A^{-1} in Loewner order. Equivalently, every nonzero residual r satisfies r^T H_[n]r >= eta*mu*r^T A^{-1}r.
predicted_failure: The most likely failure is residual-mass evacuation: for a multiscale, nearly singular correlation matrix, early updates may move most residual mass into coordinates already removed from R. The Bellman capture then sees too little of that mass during the rest of the epoch, producing a generalized eigenvector of (H_[n],mu*A^{-1}) whose eigenvalue tends to zero. This is a predicted failure mechanism, not an assertion that such a family exists.
falsifier: A later analytic verifier can reject the candidate lemma by constructing unit-diagonal SPD matrices A_m and nonzero rational or symbolic vectors r_m for which q_m=(r_m^T H_[n_m](A_m)r_m)/(lambda_min(A_m)*r_m^T A_m^{-1}r_m) tends to zero. A named check is an exact Boolean-lattice Bellman recursion followed by an exact generalized-Rayleigh-quotient calculation on a parametrized multiscale block/arrowhead family, with symbolic SPD verification and an asymptotic proof q_m->0. A single negative principal minor of H_[n]-eta*mu*A^{-1} falsifies any proposed fixed eta; a vanishing sequence falsifies existence of every universal eta.
target_implication: Target conjecture: universal constants c,C>0 give E||x_k||_A <= C exp(-c*mu*k)||x_0||_A. The candidate lemma implies the one-epoch conditional bound E[||T_pi x||_A^2|x] <= (1-eta*mu)||x||_A^2. Fresh independent epochs iterate this bound, and Jensen gives E||x_k||_A <= (1-eta*mu)^{k/2}||x_0||_A <= exp(-(eta/2)*mu*k)||x_0||_A, so C=1 and c=eta/2.
information_retained: The full matrix A and its smallest eigenvalue mu
The exact residual transition B_i r
The subset-indexed Bellman matrices H_R and PSD dual witnesses
information_discarded: The ordered prefix once its effects are encoded by (R,r)
First-moment dynamics of x or r
Higher moments beyond the quadratic capture value
Any inherited RPCD derivation, failure map, route artifact, numerical scan, or external literature
